options.text: Define the research questions and decisions they inform
options.rationale: Correct: questions drive method choice and study design.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep a usability session valid? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Give realistic tasks and let the participant think aloud
options.rationale: Correct: task-based observation yields usability evidence.

options.text: Avoid leading questions that bias responses
Tell the participant the correct path when they hesitate
Record only your own opinions, not participant behaviour
options.rationale: Findings must come from observed behaviour.

items.explanation: Correct: task-based observation yields usability evidence.

items.stem: A severity rating on a usability finding helps teams by:

options.text: Prioritising which problems to fix first
options.rationale: Correct: severity guides prioritisation of fixes.

options.text: Guaranteeing the bug count reaches zero
options.rationale: Severity rates impact, not a guarantee.
